name: MYXA UK Bass 50
status: Curated audition bank; listening approval remains subjective

moog.title: Moog Model D manual: bass and lead charts
moog.basis: Original chart architectures; redesigned controls, not verbatim imports.

dm.title: Doctor Mix: Top 5 Greatest Minimoog Sounds
dm.basis: Single-saw contour bass and saw/square octave layering.

alex.title: Alex Ball: The Prodigy Synth Tutorial
alex.basis: At 12:10: single low saw, resonant low-pass, short contour and drive. At 18:27: acid saw, octave movement, slides and distortion.

fatboy.title: Synth History: interview with Fatboy Slim
fatboy.basis: Artist describes sample-based production and the TB-303; style context, not exact patch settings.

roland.title: Roland: Beyond Acid
roland.basis: Resonance, filter-envelope decay, waveform choice and slide as acid performance controls.

reese.title: Marc Adamo / Attack: Reese Bass
reese.basis: Reese sound-design reference; our detuned-oscillator versions are original Model D adaptations.

garage.title: Attack: Making 3 Garage Basslines with Sublab
garage.basis: Triangle starting point; 38/53 ms attacks, filtered saturation, and contrasting softer and punchier bass roles.

sub.title: Attack: Subby Bass with U-He Ace
sub.basis: Triangle sub, shaped amplitude, small pitch transient and saturation. No external chorus copied.

approved.title: Existing MYXA approved bass architecture
approved.basis: User-approved resonant bass: local sonic reference; existing preset files are never modified.

method.selection: Technical usability plus spectral/envelope diversity within six style quotas. Only 50 finalists written as patches.

limits: Model D-style core, not a complete Sub 37/303/FM/Juno emulation.
Mono synthesis and room; no chorus, delay, stereo unison, sampled attacks, oscillator sync or 303 accent circuitry.
Hardware CPU/memory budget unchanged by this desktop preset bank; no firmware flashing.
